description: HIP/gfx1100 re-validation of the distributed-FFT written-field agreement on the current branch tip, using the same inputs and parameters as the original commit defc079 run.
commit_note: Current tip is 93 commits after defc079, which produced the original 3.2e-16 / 5.4e-16 rows. The source used for the re-run is a git archive of this commit with sha256 72d55db6650b2d8c065d9da1a8a3f944e33d67a9ad5138e1344e168de542104d.
gpu: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX, gfx1100, 96 compute units (device 0x744c)

original_run.note: Original hal HIP run whose values were published as 3.2e-16 and 5.4e-16. Its replicated and distributed output files are still on hal under /tmp/fix_replicated.h5, /tmp/fix_distributed.h5, /tmp/fix4_replicated.h5 and /tmp/fix4_distributed.h5.

one_rank.input: /tmp/one8.h5 (one electron at 8e-6 m in x and z, uz=0)

parameters.metric: global L2 relative over the six written E/B components, sqrt(sum((dist-rep)^2)/sum(rep^2)), and the worst absolute difference

commands.one_rank: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 picBunch --input /tmp/one8.h5 --species electrons --output cur_one8_{rep,dist}.h5 --grid 32,32,32 --cell-size 1e-6 --origin -1.6e-5,-1.6e-5,-1.6e-5 --tolerance 1e-3 --fft-mode {replicated,distributed} --backend hip
commands.four_rank: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 mpirun -n 4 picBunch --input /tmp/bunch.h5 --species electrons --output cur_four_{rep,dist}.h5 --grid 64,64,64 --cell-size 1e-6 --origin -3.2e-5,-3.2e-5,-3.2e-5 --tolerance 1e-3 --velocity-bins 1 --fft-mode {replicated,distributed} --backend hip

result.comparison: The one-rank value is identical to the published 3.2e-16. The four-rank value is 5.35e-16 versus the original 5.375e-16, a 0.5% change at the roundoff floor; the paper now quotes 5.3e-16 for this value (measured 5.348e-16), the rounding of 5.35e-16 down to one significant figure, consistent with the current paper text.

raw_logs.bundle_note: Contains provenance.txt, binary.sha256 and the four run logs.
